summary: Join our Central Bank Digital Currency training course and gain expert insights into CBDC development. Prepare for the evolving landscape of digital finance.
lede: CBDC development training helps central bank analysts and policy, payments, and financial stability professionals assess readiness and shape implementable proposals. Participants work through design options, governance and risk assessment, and stakeholder coordination, using readiness matrices, risk registers, and pilot-planning exercises to connect policy goals with delivery decisions. The course also introduces interoperability and privacy choices, while production architecture and cross-border settlement are covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate CBDC design choices, coordinate policy input, and prepare deployment-ready outputs.
audience: Product or innovation managers in central bank
Treasury or finance ministry liaison officers
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of central banking operations, payments policy, monetary policy concepts, or financial-sector regulation. No coding or software development is required, but familiarity with digital payment systems, payment rails, or policy analysis will help you get more value from the exercises. The course is suited to intermediate professionals who need to assess CBDC options, shape governance, and contribute to implementation planning rather than build production systems.
